title: African Wild Dogs Hold a Vote Before Every Hunt, and the Ballot Is a Sneeze
subject: african wild dog

scenes.text: African wild dogs hold a vote before every hunt. The ballot is a sneeze.
Before setting off, the pack gathers in a huddle, wagging and bumping each other. Then the sneezing starts.
Scientists recorded sixty-eight of these huddles in five packs in Botswana.
The more sneezes, the more likely the pack heads out to hunt.
But the votes aren't equal. If a dominant dog starts it, about three sneezes are enough. If a low-ranking dog starts it, they need around ten.
So the pack really does vote, but the boss still counts for more.

description:
African wild dogs vote on when to hunt, and the ballot is a sneeze.
In Botswana, researchers found that a dominant dog needs only about three sneezes to get the pack moving, while a low-ranking dog needs around ten.
Would you trust a sneeze election?
